title: Phase stability and compressive properties of low-density (Zr50Ti35Nb15)100-xAlx high entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by arc melting mixtures of pure metals in a Ti-gettered high purity argon atmosphere, flipped and re-melted at least ten times to achieve homogeneous distribution of elements, and subsequently cast into a copper mold.
